rename.from: onBlur validation, fromState.isValid is set when one required field still invalid
rename.to: formState.isValid flips to true when one field is optional

body:
I'm pretty sure the issue comes from the check here https://github.com/react-hook-form/react-hook-form/blob/master/src/useForm.ts#L737

In this case we have 1 valid field (the optional one) and 1 field with validation.

Btw, why is everything wrapped in useRef? :smile:

actually i think the problem lies here, the test passes when validation options are passed in the second argument. But i'm not sure if that's legacy api since it's not demonstrated in docs afaik.

https://github.com/react-hook-form/react-hook-form/blob/master/src/useForm.ts#L536-L540
thanks for the PR! ❤️ I will take a look into this, if you figure out the fix please send a PR too 😄
oops, you are right, it was supposed to be the second argument.

aahh so using it as second argument makes the test pass but breakes some other ones that look like this
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1434608/63730658-8121a600-c86c-11e9-9cb9-92162bd91cf9.png)

Testing, Seems to fix my original issue!

Now I see that isValid will not be true unless all fields also are touched! I'm not sure if its a bug though. Saw this because I have a dropdown which has the first value selected by default.
